title: MY's Advanced Weaponry
description: A small mod that adds vanilla-friendly weapons.
body: Hello! This is a new mod by a new guy to this platform. It's purpose is to extend the weaponry choice you've got in your world by adding several new types of weapons. The mod is pretty vanilla-friendly as it does not add any wild things like special animations, wild cutscenes, or disbalanced overpowered weapons. It is made to enjoy new weapons with each having something special about it.
